item.content:encoded:
Per the previous message:

If you have already reached out to multiple reviewers and received no reply, notify a staff member for assistance finding a reviewer.

That said, you might want to first take a look at the tips in this thread, specifically the second post: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews Your concept summary is full of simple errors, most noticeably many instances of incorrect capitalization and lack of punctuation.

If you want reviewers to believe that you're taking the writing process seriously and it is worth their limited time to help you, please endeavor to make sure your concept is presented with as few simple writing errors as possible.

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Junior Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
As per the Draft Forum Policies found here: http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/t-10629348/new-draft-forum-policies

Site members who can greenlight concepts are those who fulfill one or more of the following criteria:

  • They are on the Butterfly Squad Roster list of reviewers.
  • They have an entry in the Authors' Pages list or they qualify for an Author Page (they have written 3 or more successful mainsite pages).
  • They have been featured in the Reviewers' Spotlight.
  • They are a staff member.

You may want to consider messaging users listed from above to see if they'd be interested in looking at your concept. Also, reviewers would usually make it obvious when they greenlight something (such as stating that they are giving the concept a greenlight).

item.title: JS Staff Post -- Forum Crit -- Info
item.content:encoded:
Howdy hey Duganist,

As per the site Criticism Policy, forum critique should be relatively in-depth. Please edit your post to give the author a clearer direction to follow and note how your suggestions will improve their material. If you are unsure about approaching a more in-depth critique, feel free to let an experienced reviewer respond first so your critique can build on theirs.

For more information on giving critique in the Ideas Critique forum, please look at this thread.

Author,

I suggest reaching out to someone on the Butterfly Squad Roster to seek additional critique on your idea.

Thank you.

item.title: Re: [Seeking Greenlight] : Gnome Tree
item.content:encoded:
Have you seen the video of the mysterious gnomish thing skipping into the mists that was shot in Tucuman, Argentina back around 2007/8?

My spouse is very into gnomes, we have a cat, I joked the last thing we need is the cat causing a diplomatic incident with the kingdom. Sometimes she loses things and leaves out a little bagel crumbs, and then the things are found. Once we lost our wedding rings that were left on the counter, and she did the crumbs, and we found them on top of a book on the highest point on a shelf, next to a candle, don't ask me how. Play with this and you may have something. There's definitely room for a gnomish SCP file, but also be sure this hasn't been done before.

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
Since this thread was on page 6 of the forum listing with no responses, this is a quick staff reminder to the author that if you haven't yet, you should contact reviewers directly to request feedback as needed.

Please refer to this thread for more information: http://www.scp-wiki.net/forum/t-13282692/how-to-get-more-reviews

item.title: [Seeking Greenlight] : Gnome Tree
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Festive/ Horror

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch: The Gnome Tree Is a Classic Christmas tree, but with a twist, Sometimes, there are Animate Small, limbless Scandinavian Christmas Gnomes, such as dolls and ornaments, while outside of the tree, these gnomes are quite mischievous, sometimes when the tree ejects non anomalous Christmas Decorations, and these gnomes will attempt to ‘Decorate’ the containment cell, along with covering up CCTV footage

Central Narrative: These Gnomes Have a Rigid Hierarchy, where each different Gnome does it’s designed task, The Lowest in the hierarchy, The Gnome Guards, can do very simple tasks, as long as there is a group of three or more or them, these Guards are so Basic, that they have been known to accept orders from almost any life form, including humans, making it possible for testing with the object

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The tree is actually a portal to a Subterranean Festively decorated village. Where countless numbers of these gnomes reside, on a Exploration into the village with a D-Class, the live body cam footage shown gnomes never seen before, like the leader of this village, when the D-Class if found, hundreds of Gnomes Gather around him, and then made Syncretized attack, body footage cuts off for only a few disturbing images to be shown, after the footage comes back on, it shows two guard gnomes studying what the camera is, body footage cuts off again only to show A Tied up D-Class carried on his back into a large Factory located on the right side of the village, where gnomes were shown to put materials such as wool and cotton though the one side, and a dozen gnomes come out of the other side, after the D-Class was fully inside of the Factory, on the other side An Entire Army of Lower Hierarchy Gnomes, along with some High Hierarchy Gnomes
